independent_method.raw_decoder: Independent little-bit-order positive-plane decoder plus valid-padded Conv3x3 source expansion in C,ky,kx order
independent_method.cycle_scheduler: Independent q32/O4/SHARED96/cmd32/L8/D8/640-byte implementation from frozen contract constants
independent_method.train_audit: All 256 M73 payloads rehashed; 60 deterministic operator-partition objectives reconstructed across all 32 train samples
independent_method.heldout_audit: All 80 M40 payloads rehashed; all 51,840,000 source rows and 17,280 phases reconstructed

findings.title: The literal one-read held-out protocol was not preserved
findings.evidence: The failed r1 rehashed and unpacked all 40 M40 records, recovery read them again to complete the sole cycle evaluation, and M423c read them a third time for frozen read-only decomposition. r1 produced zero phase rows/cycles/speedup/decision, the catalog hash remained sealed, and independent reconstruction found no numeric mismatch, but sealed artifacts cannot prove that no human learned from the in-memory held-out histograms before changing the analyzer.
findings.required_action: Always describe this as one completed held-out cycle evaluation after one pre-evaluation infrastructure abort, with three total payload-read passes including post-result decomposition. Do not say one literal M40 read. Freeze M40 now and use a new predeclared sequence cohort for any further generalization or tuning.

findings.title: The exact r1 analyzer source is not content-addressably archived
findings.evidence: The r1 contract expects analyzer SHA 993111ed..., but that path now contains the recovery analyzer SHA d776819f.... The failed result and old SHA are sealed, but the original source blob cannot be replayed from the reviewed tree.
findings.required_action: Archive the original r1 analyzer blob if it exists, or explicitly mark r1 as historically sealed but source-unreplayable. This does not invalidate the independently reconstructed r2 numbers.

findings.title: Held-out performance is one S10 sequence, not a distribution
findings.evidence: The admitted 1.174479x result is from frozen zurich_city_09_a only. Exact arithmetic generalizes by construction, but performance depends on source-pattern distribution.
findings.required_action: Before a DATE headline, report a newly frozen multi-sequence held-out cycle distribution without changing the M423 catalog.

findings.title: Same-resource cycle equality is architectural, not physical SRAM/PPA equality
findings.evidence: q32/O4/SHARED96/cmd32/L8/D8/640-byte limits, maximum slot, and codec were independently matched, but no selected M423 RTL, SRAM macro, interconnect, power or energy result is part of M423.
findings.required_action: Keep RTL-measured speedup, energy, physical SRAM, system speedup and paper-PPA flags false until separate Synopsys and memory evidence closes them.

bottom_line: M423 is numerically sound and independently reproducible as an exact train-only q32 catalog with a 1.174479x held-out architectural cycle result versus the strong zero-elided baseline for four H67 bottleneck Conv3x3 operators. Advance it to exact RTL stimulus work. Preserve the disclosed held-out recovery scar and do not promote it to system/headline performance.
